closure.backward: _ForwardFusionTrunk.backward is the exact original _ExplicitTrunk.backward function object; save order/ctx fields unchanged
closure.complete_history: identical stable_leaf_history_v2 and all native holds
closure.first: tick -> inherited _block + inherited _sites -> inherited _base -> original sweep_tree_state_v1
closure.forcing: original representatives/group offsets -> device gather -> selected sum -> original memory.U -> CPU forcing
closure.optimizer: No optimizer, clipping or parameter.grad mutation inside candidate
closure.second: identical inherited _second and every original upward CPU boundary

exact_finite_FP32_equations.basis: FP32 CPU/device copies preserve numerical values and gather order. Same selected FP32 binary addition and same U matrix shape/order. No reassociation of tree/history reductions.
exact_finite_FP32_equations.stateful_module_constraint: The observed call closure uses a Linear U and read-only model parameters, no dropout/running-stat update or optimizer between these operations.

finite_guard.method: Per-block device aminmax; scalar maximum(-min,max); one final device maximum reduced to CPU; original denominator/eligibility algebra remains.
finite_guard.nonfinite_behavior: Fails closed on anyNaN/Inf device maximum. The old Python max over block floats could ignore a laterNaN, so behavior is stricter only for invalid nonfinite inputs.

risks: Added first-phase GPU temporaries must fit measured allocator headroom at selected512block layout.
Different scheduling may alter GPU kernel allocation or asynchronous synchronization; CPU equality is not GPU qualification.
Fusion removes transfer work but retains all original expandedCPU boundaries and full backward work.
Profile labels combine original first+forcing stages; compare end-to-end service clocks with the sameCPUthreads, not mismatched stage names.
status: Algebraically beneficial transfer opportunity; small CPU check passed; unintegrated and unqualified on GPU

symbolic_cost.K: Maximum cut-group occurrences in one block
symbolic_cost.temporary_terms: Two selected32channel buffers(256*K) + int64 indices(8*K) +8channel forcing(32*K); aminmax uses scalar outputs. Excludes CUDA kernel/library workspace/allocator.
